articles.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
articles.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

articles.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
articles.description: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".

articles.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
articles.description: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

articles.title: Spain housing crisis protest after 87-year-old woman evicted
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people marched through the streets of Madrid to protest against Spain's housing crisis after an 87-year-old woman was evicted from an apartment she had lived in for decades.

articles.title: Only diplomacy ​can solve conflict, says Iran after Trump rejects peace plan
articles.description: Iran has insisted that only diplomacy ​can solve its conflict with the US and Israel after Donald Trump said he rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait ‌of Hormuz and end the fighting.
